description_en: Calls a data algorithm service API to retrieve SQL query results
description_zh: 调用该接口调用数据算法服务API，获取SQL查询结果
name: InvokeDataAPIService

fields.help_en:
The data type of the ARRAY parameter value. For more information, see JDBCType (https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html).
Only VARCHAR, INTEGER, BIGINT, BOOLEAN, DECIMAL, and TIMESTAMP are supported
fields.help_zh:
ARRAY类型的参数值的数据类型。请参见JDBCType (https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/sql/JDBCType.html)。
目前仅支持VARCHAR、INTEGER、BIGINT、BOOLEAN、DECIMAL、TIMESTAMP
fields.name: list_param_type

fields.help_en:
The list of ARRAY parameter values. The array can contain only one group of data of the same type. For example, if the array contains numeric data, all data must be numeric.

All values are stored as the String type. The platform converts them to JDBC type objects based on the corresponding ListParamType value
fields.help_zh:
ARRAY类型的参数值列表。数组中只能放置一组类型相同的数据，例如放置数值类型数据，则全部数据为数值类型。

统一使用String类型存储，平台会跟据ListParamType对应的值转换成JDBC类型对象
fields.name: list_param_value

fields.help_en: The name of the input parameter for calling the API. This value must be consistent with the Name defined in RequestParam when you called the CreateDataAPIService operation to create the API
fields.help_zh: 调用API的入参参数名称。必须与调用CreateDataAPIService接口创建API时，RequestParam中定义的Name保持一致
fields.name: param_name

fields.help_en:
The data type. Only VARCHAR, INTEGER, BOOLEAN, BIGINT, TIMESTAMP, DECIMAL, and ARRAY types are supported.

When paramType is set to ARRAY, the ListParamType and ListParamValue parameters take effect. When paramType is set to other types, the paramValue parameter takes effect
fields.help_zh:
数据类型。目前只支持VARCHAR、INTEGER、BOOLEAN、BIGING、TIMESTAMP、DECIMAL和ARRAY类型。

当paramType选择ARRAY时，ListParamType和ListParamValue参数会生效；paramType为其他类型时，paramValue参数会生效
fields.name: param_type

fields.help_en:
The value of the input parameter for calling the API.

All values are stored as the String type. IoT Platform converts them to JDBC type objects based on the ParamType defined when the API was created.

If the API request parameter type Type is defined as ARRAY when the API is created, do not pass in this parameter. Instead, pass in ListParamType and ListParamValue
fields.help_zh:
调用API的入参参数值。

统一使用String类型存储，物联网平台会根据创建API时定义的ParamType转换成JDBC类型对象。

创建API时，如果API请求参数类型Type定义为ARRAY类型，则不传入该参数，而需传入ListParamType和ListParamValue
fields.name: param_value

parameters.help_en:
The API resource name (ARN), which is the globally unique identifier of the API. This is the ApiSrn value returned after you successfully call the CreateDataAPIService operation to create an API.

Format: `acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`

Example: `acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

The following information describes the fields in the example:

`127103983461****` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus` is the value of the ApiPath request parameter, which is the custom part of the API call address
parameters.help_zh:
API资源标识符，API的全局唯一标识。 调用CreateDataAPIService接口成功创建API，返回的ApiSrn值。

格式：`acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`

示例：`acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

以上示例中的信息说明如下：

`127103983461****`是阿里云主账号ID。
`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus`是请求参数ApiPath的值，即API调用地址的自定义部分
parameters.name: api_srn

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Do not pass in this parameter for public instances. Pass in this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135176.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135176.html）

Data.description_en: The device information returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回注册的设备信息

The API resource name (ARN), which is the globally unique identifier of the API.

Example: `acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

The following information describes the fields in the example:

`127103983461****` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus` is the custom part of the API call address
ApiSrn.description_zh:
API资源标识符，API的全局唯一标识。

示例：`acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

以上示例中的信息说明如下：

PageNo.description_en:
The page number of the displayed query results. Page numbers start from 0, and the default value is 0.
To customize the displayed result page, add a custom parameter such as pageNo to the request parameters
PageNo.description_zh:
显示的查询结果的页码。分页码从0开始，默认为0。
如果您要自定义显示结果页，建议您在请求参数中增加自定义参数，如pageNo

PageSize.description_en:
The number of query result records displayed per page.
To customize the number of records displayed per page, add a custom parameter such as pageSize to the request parameters
PageSize.description_zh:
每页显示的查询结果记录数。
如果您要自定义每页显示的记录数，建议您在请求参数中增加自定义参数，如pageSize

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
